purpose: Blank manufacturer OEM replacement verification intake. NOT an approval or vehicle simulator.
never_assume: original VIN code proves installed engine/transmission still original
similar dimensions imply safety or electrical fitment
supplier cross-reference equals Saab OEM supersession
production serial VIN cutoff equals a replacement part number
software or immobilizer module needs no programming
same chassis-option classification means same left/right SKU

required_fields.description: Full actual VIN privately and method verified against stamped body and official year code
US or CA factory market and homologation, not assembly country
Exact physical engine code/serial, gearbox stamping and donor/replacement history
Function, subsystem and OEM drawing position
Visible original part number, casting and revision/production marks
Saab WebEPC per-VIN authorized lookup page/illustration locator and access date
Original Saab manufacturer part for that VIN and option
Explicit old to new forward relation or conditional service kit
Build cutoffs, engine, transmission, body type, position/side and US/Canada market restrictions
Bolts/fastener revisions, seals, brackets, dimension/clearance and service prerequisites
Physical old/new part condition, deterioration and qualified inspection outcome
Exact original source link(s), page/locator and verification dates

sample_case_note: Official Saab 9-3 12801010 to 32021815 is a conditional reuse-old-black-slider kit, not drop-in full module. Template remains blank for any actual VIN.
